verses.original: שִׁמְע֞וּ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַ֚ל כָּל־ הַמִּשְׁפָּחָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלֵ֛יתִי מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh ’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·ḵem bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ‘al kāl- ham·miš·pā·ḥāh ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lê·ṯî mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lê·mōr
verses.literal: Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you O children of Israel against the whole family that I brought up out of the land of Egypt . . .
verses.literalPt: OUVI esta palavra que o SENHOR fala contra vós, filhos de Israel, contra toda a família que fiz subir da terra do Egito, dizendo:

verses.original: רַ֚ק אֶתְכֶ֣ם יָדַ֔עְתִּי מִכֹּ֖ל מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת הָאֲדָמָ֑ה עַל־ כֵּן֙ אֶפְקֹ֣ד עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת כָּל־ עֲוֺנֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: raq ’eṯ·ḵem yā·ḏa‘·tî mik·kōl miš·pə·ḥō·wṯ hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ‘al- kên ’ep̄·qōḏ ‘ă·lê·ḵem ’êṯ kāl- ‘ă·wō·nō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: Only you have I known from all the families of the earth therefore . . . I will punish you for all your iniquities
verses.literalPt: De todas as famílias da terra só a vós vos tenho conhecido; portanto eu vos punirei por todas as vossas iniqüidades.

verses.original: הֲיֵלְכ֥וּ שְׁנַ֖יִם יַחְדָּ֑ו בִּלְתִּ֖י אִם־ נוֹעָֽדוּ׃
verses.literal: Can two walk together without . . . agreeing where to go
verses.literalPt: Porventura andarão dois juntos, se não estiverem de acordo?

verses.original: הֲיִשְׁאַ֤ג אַרְיֵה֙ בַּיַּ֔עַר וְטֶ֖רֶף אֵ֣ין ל֑וֹ הֲיִתֵּ֨ן כְּפִ֤יר קוֹלוֹ֙ מִמְּעֹ֣נָת֔וֹ בִּלְתִּ֖י אִם־ לָכָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yiš·’aḡ ’ar·yêh bay·ya·‘ar wə·ṭe·rep̄ ’ên lōw hă·yit·tên kə·p̄îr qō·w·lōw mim·mə·‘ō·nā·ṯōw bil·tî ’im- lā·ḵāḏ
verses.literal: Does a lion roar in the forest when he has no prey Does a young lion growl . . . in his den if he has caught nothing
verses.literalPt: Rugirá o leão no bosque, sem que tenha presa? Levantará o leãozinho no seu covil a sua voz, se nada tiver apanhado?

verses.original: הֲתִפֹּ֤ל צִפּוֹר֙ עַל־ פַּ֣ח הָאָ֔רֶץ וּמוֹקֵ֖שׁ אֵ֣ין לָ֑הּ הֲיַֽעֲלֶה־ פַּח֙ מִן־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה וְלָכ֖וֹד לֹ֥א יִלְכּֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ṯip·pōl ṣip·pō·wr ‘al- paḥ hā·’ā·reṣ ū·mō·w·qêš ’ên lāh hă·ya·‘ă·leh- paḥ min- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh wə·lā·ḵō·wḏ lō yil·kō·wḏ
verses.literal: Does a bird land in a snare where no bait has been set Does a trap spring from the ground when it has nothing to catch
verses.literalPt: Cairá a ave no laço em terra, se não houver armadilha para ela? Levantar-se-á da terra o laço, sem que tenha apanhado alguma coisa?

verses.original: אִם־ יִתָּקַ֤ע שׁוֹפָר֙ בְּעִ֔יר וְעָ֖ם לֹ֣א יֶחֱרָ֑דוּ אִם־ תִּהְיֶ֤ה רָעָה֙ בְּעִ֔יר וַיהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yit·tā·qa‘ šō·w·p̄ār bə·‘îr wə·‘ām lō ye·ḥĕ·rā·ḏū ’im- tih·yeh rā·‘āh bə·‘îr Yah·weh lō ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: If a ram’s horn sounds in a city do the people not tremble If calamity comes to a city has not the LORD caused it
verses.literalPt: Tocar-se-á a trombeta na cidade, e o povo não estremecerá? Sucederá algum mal na cidade, sem que o SENHOR o tenha feito?

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֧א יַעֲשֶׂ֛ה אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה דָּבָ֑ר כִּ֚י אִם־ גָּלָ֣ה סוֹד֔וֹ אֶל־ עֲבָדָ֖יו הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō ya·‘ă·śeh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh dā·ḇār kî ’im- gā·lāh sō·w·ḏōw ’el- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw han·nə·ḇî·’îm
verses.literal: Surely the Lord GOD does nothing . . . without . . . revealing His plan to His servants the prophets
verses.literalPt: Certamente o Senhor DEUS não fará coisa alguma, sem ter revelado o seu segredo aos seus servos, os profetas.

verses.original: אַרְיֵ֥ה שָׁאָ֖ג מִ֣י לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ דִּבֶּ֔ר מִ֖י לֹ֥א יִנָּבֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’ar·yêh šā·’āḡ mî lō yî·rā ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh dib·ber mî lō yin·nā·ḇê
verses.literal: The lion has roared who will not fear The Lord GOD has spoken who will not prophesy
verses.literalPt: Rugiu o leão, quem não temerá? Falou o Senhor DEUS, quem não profetizará?

verses.original: הַשְׁמִ֙יעוּ֙ עַל־ אַרְמְנ֣וֹת בְּאַשְׁדּ֔וֹד וְעַֽל־ אַרְמְנ֖וֹת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְאִמְר֗וּ הֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ עַל־ הָרֵ֣י שֹׁמְר֔וֹן וּרְא֞וּ מְהוּמֹ֤ת רַבּוֹת֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ וַעֲשׁוּקִ֖ים בְּקִרְבָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: haš·mî·‘ū ‘al- ’ar·mə·nō·wṯ bə·’aš·dō·wḏ wə·‘al- ’ar·mə·nō·wṯ bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wə·’im·rū hê·’ā·sə·p̄ū ‘al- hā·rê šō·mə·rō·wn ū·rə·’ū mə·hū·mōṯ rab·bō·wṯ bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh wa·‘ă·šū·qîm bə·qir·bāh
verses.literal: Proclaim to the citadels of Ashdod and to the citadels of Egypt . . . Assemble on the mountains of Samaria see the great unrest in the city and the acts of oppression in her midst
verses.literalPt: Fazei ouvir isso nos palácios de Asdode, e nos palácios da terra do Egito, e dizei: Ajuntai-vos sobre os montes de Samaria, e vede que grandes alvoroços há no meio dela, e como são oprimidos dentro dela.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ יָדְע֥וּ עֲשׂוֹת־ נְכֹחָ֖ה נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה הָאֽוֹצְרִ֛ים חָמָ֥ס וָשֹׁ֖ד בְּאַרְמְנֽוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yā·ḏə·‘ū ‘ă·śō·wṯ- nə·ḵō·ḥāh nə·’um- Yah·weh hā·’ō·wṣ·rîm ḥā·mās wā·šōḏ bə·’ar·mə·nō·w·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: For they know not how to do right declares the LORD They store up violence and destruction in their citadels
verses.literalPt: Porque não sabem fazer o que é reto, diz o SENHOR, aqueles que entesouram nos seus palácios a violência e a destruição.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה צַ֖ר וּסְבִ֣יב הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהוֹרִ֤ד מִמֵּךְ֙ עֻזֵּ֔ךְ וְנָבֹ֖זּוּ אַרְמְנוֹתָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣar ū·sə·ḇîḇ hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hō·w·riḏ mim·mêḵ ‘uz·zêḵ wə·nā·ḇōz·zū ’ar·mə·nō·w·ṯā·yiḵ
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says An enemy will surround the land he will pull down . . . your strongholds and plunder your citadels
verses.literalPt: Portanto, o Senhor DEUS diz assim: O inimigo virá, e cercará a terra, derrubará a tua fortaleza, e os teus palácios serão saqueados.

verses.original: כֹּה֮ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֒ כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ יַצִּ֨יל הָרֹעֶ֜ה מִפִּ֧י הָאֲרִ֛י שְׁתֵּ֥י כְרָעַ֖יִם א֣וֹ בְדַל־ אֹ֑זֶן כֵּ֣ן יִנָּצְל֞וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן בִּפְאַ֥ת מִטָּ֖ה וּבִדְמֶ֥שֶׁק עָֽרֶשׂ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer yaṣ·ṣîl hā·rō·‘eh mip·pî hā·’ă·rî šə·tê ḵə·rā·‘a·yim ’ōw ḇə·ḏal- ’ō·zen kên yin·nā·ṣə·lū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bə·šō·mə·rō·wn bip̄·’aṯ miṭ·ṭāh ū·ḇiḏ·me·šeq ‘ā·reś
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says As the shepherd snatches from the mouth of the lion two legs or a piece of an ear so the Israelites . . . dwelling in Samaria will be rescued having just the corner of a bed or the cushion of a couch
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Como o pastor livra da boca do leão as duas pernas, ou um pedaço da orelha, assim serão livrados os filhos de Israel que habitam em Samaria, no canto da cama, e em Damasco, num leito.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ וְהָעִ֖ידוּ בְּבֵ֣ית יַֽעֲקֹ֑ב נְאֻם־ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י הַצְּבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū wə·hā·‘î·ḏū bə·ḇêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ nə·’um- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê haṣ·ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Hear and testify against the house of Jacob declares the Lord GOD the God of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Ouvi, e protestai contra a casa de Jacó, diz o Senhor DEUS, o Deus dos Exércitos;

verses.original: כִּ֗י בְּי֛וֹם פָּקְדִ֥י פִשְׁעֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עָלָ֑יו וּפָֽקַדְתִּי֙ עַל־ מִזְבְּח֣וֹת בֵּֽית־ אֵ֔ל וְנִגְדְּעוּ֙ קַרְנ֣וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְנָפְל֖וּ לָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kî bə·yō·wm pā·qə·ḏî p̄iš·‘ê- yiś·rā·’êl ‘ā·lāw ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘al- miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ bêṯ- ’êl wə·niḡ·də·‘ū qar·nō·wṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·nā·p̄ə·lū lā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: On the day I punish Israel for their transgressions I will visit destruction on the altars of Bethel the horns of the altar will be cut off and they will fall to the ground
verses.literalPt: Pois no dia em que eu punir as transgressões de Israel, também castigarei os altares de Betel; e as pontas do altar serão cortadas, e cairão por terra.

verses.original: וְהִכֵּיתִ֥י בֵית־ הַחֹ֖רֶף עַל־ בֵּ֣ית הַקָּ֑יִץ וְאָבְד֞וּ בָּתֵּ֣י הַשֵּׁ֗ן וְסָפ֛וּ בָּתִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hik·kê·ṯî ḇêṯ- ha·ḥō·rep̄ ‘al- bêṯ haq·qā·yiṣ wə·’ā·ḇə·ḏū bāt·tê haš·šên wə·sā·p̄ū bāt·tîm rab·bîm nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will tear down the winter house along with the summer house the houses of ivory will also perish and the great houses will come to an end declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: E ferirei a casa de inverno juntamente com a casa de verão; e as casas de marfim perecerão, e as grandes casas terão fim, diz o SENHOR.
